method: Manual inspection of four native final-video contact sheets (six sampled frames per scene), low-resolution animation previews and sampled decoded GIF frames.

observations.MatrixMultiplication: Sliding guides, copied operands, all six entries and final product inspected.
observations.MatrixTranspose: Upright entry motion, rectangular dimensions and final transposition inspected.
observations.GaussJordanInverse: Arc swap, full augmented operations, synchronized multiple label, safe arrow lane and inverse extraction inspected.
observations.PlaneIntersection: Plane window margins, moving common point, fixed formula and orbit inspected.

limits: Sampled visual review; full-frame format/timing/blank/border checks are recorded in validation.json.
